integrity: All four equilibrium equations are imposed without asymptotic simplification. The complete stationary classification follows analytically from an exact scalar bijection; finite numerical checks only corroborate algebra.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns nonnegative steady states of exactly two symmetric patches with logistic response and exponential softmax movement; no orbital stability, convergence, graphon, or other-network generalization is asserted. Priority assessment is literature-limited.
title: Global equilibrium classification and a high-bias survival transition in two-patch logistic chemotaxis
